records.derivation: Paris's deliberation of 3 June 2025 in the 2027 catalogue sets €0.80, €1.00, €1.70, €2.60 and €3.60 (1- to 5-star) and applies the departmental, regional and article L2531-18 additional taxes. The ministry gives these as 10%, 15% and 200% in Île-de-France, so the total is the rate × 3.25, rounded to the cent. This is exactly how DGFiP's 2026 tarif_total relates to the same rates (1.7 → 5.53). In the DGFiP catalogue, categories 6, 5, 4, 3 and 2 are 1- to 5-star tourist hotels.

records.derivation: The total tax per person and night is €12.00 (5-star), €8.40 (4-star) and €7.00 (other establishments). The categories are exhaustive, so 1- to 3-star hotels fall under 'other establishments'. The tax is part of the VAT base, and hotel stays carry 10% VAT, so the guest pays the total × 1.10: €13.20, €9.24 and €7.70. Rates and surcharge are set from 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027.

records.scope: Overnight stays in Amsterdam: 12.5% of the charge for the stay that is subject to VAT (that is, before VAT). records.scope: Paid overnight stays in Berlin (Übernachtungsteuer): 7.5% of the net charge for the stay, excluding extras such as breakfast. The source does not state the VAT rate, so the tax is counted on the full price.

source.quote: Die Höhe der Übernachtungsteuer beträgt 7,5 % des Nettoentgelts für die Übernachtung (ohne Nebenkosten, wie z.B. Frühstück).

supportingSources.title: FAQ Übernachtungsteuer (City Tax)
supportingSources.quote: Ab dem 1. Januar 2025 gelten insbesondere folgende Änderungen**: • Der Steuersatz wurde auf 7,5 % angehoben.

records.derivation: 7.5% of the net charge for the stay. The Senate finance department says the rate became 7.5% on 1 January 2025.

records.name: Geneva
records.scope: Hotel stays in the canton of Geneva: a single rate of CHF 4.25 per person per night (taxe de séjour, RTour art. 10, amended with effect from 1 January 2026).

source.title: Règlement d'exécution de la loi sur le tourisme (RTour), I 1 60.01, art. 10
source.quote: les montants de la taxe de séjour par personne et par nuitée sont les suivants : a) tarif unique 4,25 fr.

records.name: London
records.scope: No overnight visitor levy applies in England. The government intends to give English mayors the power to introduce one, but has not yet legislated. Scotland and Wales already have the power.

source.title: Overnight visitor levy in England: consultation
source.quote: The Government intends to introduce a visitor levy power in England to enable Mayors and potentially other local leaders to take full advantage of the economic opportunities offered by the visitor economy, as seen elsewhere in Great Britain. In Scotland and Wales, all local authorities already have the legal power to apply a visitor levy.

supportingSources.title: Visitor Levy in England: government response
supportingSources.quote: Subject to Parliamentary approval, we expect local leaders to be able to set out plans for how revenues will be invested by March 2028.

records.derivation: English local authorities do not have the power to levy a visitor tax, unlike those in Scotland and Wales. The government's response says the power still needs Parliamentary approval, with local plans expected by March 2028. So no levy applies in London now.

records.name: Kraków
records.scope: Kraków stopped charging its opłata miejscowa (local fee) after 2015. A resolution to reintroduce it from 2027 is in public consultation (6–27 November 2026), so stays from 1 January 2027 are not covered.

source.title: Konsultacje społeczne: Na jakich zasadach wprowadzić tzw. opłatę turystyczną w Krakowie?
source.quote: Od 6 do 27 listopada 2026 r. potrwają konsultacje społeczne projektu uchwały dotyczącej wprowadzenia w Krakowie opłaty miejscowej

supportingSources.title: Radni przyjęli rezolucję w sprawie opłaty turystycznej
supportingSources.quote: Taka opłata miejscowa była pobierana w Krakowie w latach 2004–2015, ale jej pobór wstrzymano

records.derivation: The city says the fee was charged from 2004 to 2015 and then stopped. Its November 2026 consultation is on introducing it again (wprowadzenie), so no fee applies until a resolution takes effect.

records.derivation: The Eurométropole's deliberation of 27 June 2025 is still the one in force in the 2027 catalogue. Under DGFiP's rules it took effect on 1 January 2026. It covers Strasbourg (67482) and sets €0.80, €1.00, €1.70, €2.60 and €3.60 (1- to 5-star) with only the departmental additional tax, which is 10%. So the total is the rate × 1.10. In the DGFiP catalogue, categories 6, 5, 4, 3 and 2 are 1- to 5-star tourist hotels.

records.name: Alicante
records.scope: No tourist tax applies in the Comunitat Valenciana. The regional tourist-stay tax (IVET, popularly the «tasa turística») and its voluntary municipal surcharge were repealed by Decreto ley 12/2023 before they took effect.

source.title: Decreto ley 12/2023, de 10 de noviembre, del Consell, de derogación de la Ley 7/2022 (DOGV núm. 9719, 14 de noviembre de 2023)
source.quote: Queda derogada la Ley 7/2022, de 16 de diciembre, de la Generalitat, de medidas fiscales para impulsar el turismo sostenible

supportingSources.title: Decreto ley 12/2023, preámbulo
supportingSources.quote: su objeto es la creación del Impuesto Valenciano sobre Estancias Turísticas (IVET), como un impuesto propio de la Generalitat Valenciana que grava la capacidad económica puesta de manifiesto por su estancia en determinados establecimientos turísticos situados en el territorio de la Comunitat Valenciana, impuesto que ha sido popularmente conocido como «tasa turística»

supportingSources.title: Decreto ley 12/2023, preámbulo
supportingSources.quote: momento a partir del cual los ayuntamientos podrían decidir aplicar de manera voluntaria el recargo establecido en la disposición adicional primera

records.derivation: Ley 7/2022 created the Valencian tourist-stay tax and the only basis for a municipal surcharge on it. Decreto ley 12/2023 repeals that law before it took effect, so no tourist tax applies in Alicante. No later law creating one was found.
